items.title: Associated primes of a fibre of a projective module do not meet the extended maximal ideal
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a module projective over a local ring whose fibre is a finite module over a Noetherian ring, no associated prime of the fibre generates the unit ideal together with the extended maximal ideal (statement lines 4314-4327, tag 05JD-adjacent). The proof uses the semi-locality and universal injectivity conclusions to see that a prime associated to the fibre remains associated after localising away from the zerodivisors of the fibre, hence corresponds to a prime of the localised ring, and is contained in a prime corresponding to an associated prime of the fibre. The transport of associatedness is the substance, so the claim is H2.
